cues.text: Pick a picture sticker. I'll say its name and spell the word. Follow every dotted letter with your finger. Remember the little lines and dots. Let's make rainbow writing!
You wrote the whole word! Look at your rainbow writing. Great job! Would you like to choose another picture?

notes: Reuse all other approved word names and isolated alphabet spellings. Warm natural delivery; listen to each generated clip. No browser speech synthesis or substitute voices.
